description.html: Arcadia EarthPro CaPro-MG is a specialized calcium supplement that combines calcium and magnesium in an optimal ratio for reptiles. Magnesium is a cofactor in more than 300 enzyme reactions and is essential for the body to use calcium properly.

Apply by dusting it over insects and other live food right before feeding. Daily use of CaPro-MG is recommended, together with the EarthPro-A vitamin supplement once a week. This protocol provides complete nutritional balance for reptiles kept in captivity.

Especially suitable for insect-eating species - geckos, chameleons and diurnal lizard species that need a high calcium intake. The Arcadia EarthPro line was developed in collaboration with zoo veterinarians and herpetologists.
